name: pulse-motion-interactions
description: Designs Motion React animations and gestures for components in this Laravel app. Use for micro-interactions, variants, hover, focus, tap, drag, scroll effects, autoplay, marquee behaviour, reduced motion, animation performance, and gesture support.
purpose: Make animation clarify state or interaction while preserving accessibility, performance, and browser gestures.
single_responsibility: Motion React animation and gesture behaviour for components: intent, triggers, reduced motion, stable variants, and scroll-safe gestures.
triggers: Component adds or changes Motion React animation
Drag, swipe, hover, tap, scroll, autoplay, or marquee behaviour is involved
Reduced motion or animation performance needs handling
completion_criteria: Animation intent and trigger are defined
Animations use transform and opacity where possible
Variants and transition objects are stable and gestures do not block native vertical scroll
Listeners and animation frames are cleaned up
validation_criteria: Keyboard and touch alternatives exist when interaction needs them
failure_handling: If an animation cannot respect reduced motion or would block native scroll, stop and report the conflict instead of shipping the motion.
Report any Motion API or gesture behaviour that could not be verified.
escalation_path: Route uncertain `motion/react` APIs or gesture behaviour through pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when motion intent requires a design or scope decision.
Hand animation performance concerns to pulse-performance-vercel and accessible-alternative needs to pulse-accessibility-wcag.
responsibilities: Stop or adapt long-running animations during direct user interaction when appropriate.
Replace large transform, parallax, and autoplay motion with opacity or static states when reduced motion is preferred.
non_responsibilities: General React state not tied to animation.
